commonRules.authority: NEW authored Planar5 procedures only. Exact input authority is 730 applied-reviewed / 118 pending / 0 accepted-unapplied, 454 standalone procedures. commonRules.native: Each native card, Core entry, book placement and class-access row is copied unchanged below. All five are rank 8, Action, range 120 ft, V/S/F, base 21 RP, minimum actual class level 15. Demiplane has two book placements but its actual grants remain Conjuration. Maze uses Wizard Illusion versus Cleric/Mage Universal. Do not create access from a school heading. Original Instantaneous fields remain evidence even where a NEW ongoing component is selected. Gloom Bind retains Core Until dispelled and both conflicting destination names.
commonRules.preflight: Use an actually acquired and prepared matrix or an exact class permission. Check remaining Action, usable voice, free gesturing hand and actual focus, rank/RP, target identity, actual range and unobstructed line of effect. A known invalid declaration is rejected before payment. Missing authoritative physical/source prerequisites put the dependent case on hold; a held test is not a successful or paid cast. A lawful declaration defeated only by hidden facts spends its committed costs and produces no diagnostic locating or classifying the hidden fact. Revalidate each component at effect resolution. No retargeting or refund on failure.
commonRules.commit: Commit RP, components, source-history and concentration before interruption/save. Cost is 21 plus the exact pre-cast Dissonance surcharge and printed extras only. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); +1 at limit, +2 at limit+3, ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. First distinct actual Wizard prepared family gives zero BASE strain only; otherwise rank8 base strain is 2. Consecutive same-family Refrain adds 1/2/3 capped at3, idle turns do not reset it. No class perk is assumed without acquisition. An interrupted or resisted cast retains costs and never restores displaced concentration. Exact legal Counterspell/Dispel sources keep their own ranks/costs/checks; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/check INT+PB versus18 for rank8, not rank5 Greater Dispel.
commonRules.timing: Use actual elapsed seconds; generated spaces have 1:1 time. An expiry at timestamp t occurs before a newly beginning action at t; already committed atomic crossings finish before an external closure event can settle them. Ordinary Ready commits at preparation, uses held concentration, releases once with a remaining Reaction after its completed trigger, and expires at the next own regular START. Release does not pay/cast/update cadence again; effect deadlines begin on release. A continuing effect retains concentration normally after release. No extra regular START, recharge, rest, recovery, Refrain reset, Hunt pause or resource refresh is created by moving planes.
commonRules.transport: Creation of a room/cell is not itself body travel. Door creation is a connection; its use is physical planar crossing. Maze, Seal of Banishment and Gloom Bind admissions are planar displacement, not teleportation. Record ACCEPT versus RESIST separately from save result. Voluntary or forced travel restrictions use their exact predicates, not a generic planar tag. Every creature is separate from gear, including carried unconscious allies, mounts and summons. Check whole-body geometry and actual custody for each. No splitting, duplicating inventories, body-as-cargo target-cap bypass or unprovided portal provider. Record current plane, actual travel provenance, origin anchor and source-character identity separately from native realm, which may remain unknown.
commonRules.hardControl: Maze, each Seal of Banishment child and Gloom Bind count as encounter-removal/hard denial and require the shared source-character/target/encounter gate across all that source character’s spells, classes and companions. Spend the gate only on actual establishment, not a resisted or preflight-rejected cast. Prior expenditure or a proved immunity prevents only the applicable control; no new target or refund. No nesting or refresh bypass. Record actual save ability, bonus, DC, die and any chosen lawful reaction/reroll; no generic monster save profile is invented.
commonRules.closureExtension: NEW P5-CLOSE extension applies ONLY to true Demiplane room removal, Maze termination and Seal of Banishment child termination. It explicitly reuses BAN-CLOSE-03, BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03 and BAN-CONFLICT-04: end the source first, settle every extant identity exactly once to its fixed origin plane/anchor (secondary occupants project their local offset onto the recorded entry/creation anchor), ignore ONLY transport-prevention at the terminal endpoints. Try full body at anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral order (south, west, east, north, then SW, SE, NW, NE on the declared grid). Never pass a wall/occupied space or search farther. If none fits, retain a logical-anchor placementConflict with no fabricated footprint, support, falling, movement or new actions; independently legal actions and clocks continue. Normalize only when obstruction is actually removed or lawful relocation resolves it. Loose items retain pending placement/custody, never disappear. Source has ended even while conflict remains. This exception does not permit voluntary entry, internal escape, new portal crossings or Gloom release and does not broaden the pre-existing BAN interfaces.
commonRules.custody: Every item has one stable identity, provenance, current holder or ground location, weight, Load and independent deadline. Living bodies, corpses and source-ended absent entities are distinct. Mandatory anatomy/source endings happen first; never delay an expiry to preserve a convenient shape or manufacture a corpse. A generated space supplies only expressly authored floor/boundaries/light/respiration support; no harvestable matter, permanent supplies, inhabitants, treasure, immunity, protected rest, native status, soul rule or automatic Extraction. Preserve cargo danger, taint, claims and Hunt records. Once initiated, Hunt death is normally final except the owner’s extremely rare Divine/Abyssal exception; none of these spells grants that exception.
commonRules.qualification: Static proposed authorship and data-only fixtures are not game execution or observed campaign results. Real actor acquisition, creature profiles, destination geometry, native/cosmology facts, environmental needs and equipment not established by a source remain explicit whole-case/branch holds. No runtime, human-play, balance, cosmology or release approval. All closed feat335, completed16/72 and applied spell cohorts remain closed.

localRules.predicate: NEW P5-EXTRAPLANAR applies only to this spell: affirmatively qualifies an actual creature with an explicit operative extraplanar source flag, or a recorded most recent successful cross-plane body arrival from a different plane into its current plane. A source-created body also qualifies only if that source explicitly proves foreign-planar provenance. This operational travel predicate may include a returning traveler; it is not proof of native origin or a global definition of outsider. Mere summoned/Fiend/Elemental/plane-themed status is insufficient. Unknown qualification is retained, not resolved to native. A publicly known ineligible target is invalid before payment; a lawfully declared target with hidden unproved qualification gets no effect and no diagnostic. A missing authoritative basis in a proposed positive campaign case is a whole dependent-case hold.
localRules.targets: Select one to three distinct perceived creatures within120ft/line of effect in a fixed declared order. Pay one cast once; each eligible target independently makes the printed CHA save with actual bonuses against the actual class-school DC. ACCEPT/RESIST, immunity, hard-control history, fit and carried separate-creature handling are separate per target. A resisted, unqualified, unavailable or immune component does not substitute another target, refund the cast or undo successful siblings. No child without successful admission; no child refresh on a target already under this spell.
localRules.cells: NEW concentration and a60-second parent deadline from resolution; each successful target owns an independent generated BAN-CELL-03 cell, expressly extending its finite body+clearance topology/support/agency and BAN-ADMIT-03 only to these children. A Medium5x5x6 body gets15x15x15ft; retain exact dimension rules for other actual profiles. No native/home/afterlife destination. Copy actual origin plane/anchor, custody, travel-intent and source identity, not a guessed origin world. Parent concentration begins at commitment, even if no child succeeds; if none succeeds it ends immediately after resolution.
localRules.endings: Each child ends independently on actual application suppression, a successful perceived-effect dispel, primary death/source expiry or actual lawful primary departure. P5-CLOSE settles extant secondaries/items without recreating an ended body. Parent concentration loss or common absolute deadline closes all remaining children once. Last child ended closes parent concentration. A distant suppressed caster does not automatically erase cells. Cell admission/mandatory anatomy follows the exact copied BAN contract: mandatory body event first, expand only indispensable clearance; independent visitors require actual source/fit before any expansion. This is a NEW explicit extension for Seal of Banishment; no general cell power or new cosmology is granted.
